236:     def evaluate_metric(self, metric: float, *, job_id: int | None = None) -> str:
237:         direction = self.best_direction()
238:         records = self.all()
239:         if job_id is not None:
240:             records = [record for record in records if _record_job_as_int(record) == job_id]
241:         if not records:
242:             return "keep"
243:         kept = [r for r in records if r.accepted]
244:         compare_against = None
245:         if kept:
246:             compare_against = _coerce_metric_float(
247:                 _metric_value_for_record(kept[0], self.primary_metric_name())
248:             )
249:             for record in kept[1:]:
250:                 candidate = _coerce_metric_float(
251:                     _metric_value_for_record(record, self.primary_metric_name())
252:                 )
253:                 if direction == "higher" and candidate > compare_against:
254:                     compare_against = candidate
255:                 if direction == "lower" and candidate < compare_against:
256:                     compare_against = candidate
257:         else:
258:             compare_against = _coerce_metric_float(
259:                 _metric_value_for_record(records[0], self.primary_metric_name())
260:             )
261:         improved = metric > compare_against if direction == "higher" else metric < compare_against
262:         return "keep" if improved else "discard"
